description: Lists, approves or rejects the creator sample requests on the campaign brand's TikTok Shop. action list shows each open request with its request_id, creator, product, approve-by day and the sample rule of that product; it changes nothing. action list also shows the brand's approved samples with their shipping stage, tracking number and ship-by day; delivered comes only from the carrier's tracking. action approve or reject takes request_ids (at most 25, copied from list) and, for reject, a reject_reason. Approving commits the shop to ship a sample, so the first approve or reject call changes nothing: it returns the requests it will act on, names every id it will not act on, and returns a confirmation_ref. A call with the same arguments and that ref acts on them once. Approve and reject are for a Brand Manager. Sample rules are edited in the Storika web app, not here. Example: campaign_id spring-launch, action list.

action.description: list reads; approve and reject change the shop.

confirmation_ref.description: Absent: the call returns a proposal and a one-use confirmation_ref and changes nothing. Present: the confirmation_ref that proposal returned; Storika applies it once, and refuses it while the marketer has not pressed Approve on the Storika card shown with the proposal.

reject_reason.description: reject only: the reason TikTok shows the creator.

request_ids.description: approve and reject only: request_id values from list.

name: handle_sample_requests
title: Handle TikTok Shop Sample Requests
